open_account.title: Open account
open_account.description: Return the account for this (category, holder_id), opening it if it does not exist yet. Opening is lazy and idempotent: an account exists because something was posted to it, never because its holder merely registered, and asking twice returns the same account rather than a second one.

get_account.title: Read account
get_account.description: Read one account by its storage id.

list_accounts.title: List accounts
list_accounts.description: List the chart of accounts, oldest-opened first.

args.description: Cap the accounts returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

close_account.title: Close account
close_account.description: Stamp an account closed. Refused while it still carries a balance, and refused if it is already closed.

account_balance.title: Read balance
account_balance.description: Fold one account's balance: everything debited to it minus everything credited from it, over every entry naming it. There is no stored balance anywhere in this module, so this is computed on every call.

post_entry.title: Post entry
post_entry.description: Append one journal entry, debiting one account and crediting another for the same amount. There is no update and no delete: a mistake is corrected by posting a new entry that names the original in reverses_entry_id, and an entry may be reversed at most once.

list_entries.title: List entries
list_entries.description: Read one account's ledger, both sides, ordered on when the event occurred and falling back to when it was posted, oldest first so a running balance can be accumulated down the page.

args.description: The account whose ledger to read.
Cap the entries returned. Zero or absent means the default page.
